purpose: Development-only causal gate for feeding exact-model elites back into genuine HGS generation.
selection_rule: For each H1 development case, use the view with the best exact population-archive objective. This is an explicitly seen-case development choice and cannot confirm generality.
candidate: Two one-second genuine-HGS epochs. After epoch one, the complete nonlinear ReSETP model selects four elites from the feasible population and inserts them into epoch two's breeding population.
control: One uninterrupted two-second genuine-HGS run with the same proxy view and the same final exact population re-ranking.
gate: Across the three paired development cases, epochal migration must have zero strict losses and at least one strict win versus the continuous exact-archive control. All solutions must be feasible.
no_rescue: Do not change cases, selected views, seeds, times, epoch count, elite count, or archive limit.
Do not call a pass fresh or formal.
If it fails, stop epochal migration; do not add a third epoch.
